children: Delivery Hero scrapped plans for co-founder Niklas Ostberg to step down as chief executive, citing Uber Technologies' $14.8 billion takeover bid.
The German food-delivery company had said in May that Ostberg would step down in March of next year under plans for a leadership transition.

However, the company said Ostberg would continue in his role due to the change in its situation. Earlier this month, Delivery Hero said it was in favor of a $14.8 billion takeover bid from Uber Technologies and advised shareholders to accept it.
